aboutText: With more than three decades of experience, Burdens has established itself as the leading supplier of plumbing, bathroom, and building products in Melbourne. Our Melbourne store is designed for trade professionals, offering everything from essential fixtures to premium finishes. We pride ourselves on reliability, expertise, and a commitment to supporting local projects with quality supplies and exceptional service.
servicesText: As trade specialists, Burdens offers an extensive selection of plumbing, bathroom, and building supplies tailored to professional needs. Our Melbourne store is stocked with premium products to support every stage of your project, from rough-in to final fit-off. We focus on providing high-quality, durable materials that meet Australian standards.
